metadata.description: Expected outcome per use case (UC1-UC9), written from the policy text. Seed of the case test set for the ontology/rules.
metadata.status: DRAFT: checked against the policy by the assistant, to be reviewed by a person
metadata.verdicts: reject = not acceptable | accept = acceptable | explain = not under standard rules, only via the Explain route | amount = the answer is a maximum amount

required: The maximum loan is 90% of the boat (EUR 270,000) plus 90% of the mooring (EUR 45,000) = EUR 315,000, so EUR 320,000 is too high (AB 5.5.12)
Interest-only is not allowed for a houseboat (AB 5.5.12)
The boat loan must be repaid within the expected lifetime (25 years), so 30 years is too long (AB 5.5.12)
The mooring part must be repaid in 20 years (AB 5.5.12)
A savings mortgage whose savings product is not pledged counts as interest-only in full (verkapt aflossingsvrij, AB 1.1.3)
Total interest-only is EUR 300,000, above the cap of EUR 150,000 (and above 30% of EUR 600,000 = EUR 180,000) (AB 1.1.3)
forbidden: Saying the interest-only limit is met
Counting only the EUR 100,000 as interest-only

required: With a Desktop Taxatie the maximum is 90% of market value = EUR 360,000, so EUR 380,000 is too high (AB 5.5.2)
With a (validated) valuation report the maximum is 100% = EUR 400,000, so the advisor can order a full valuation report (AB 5.5.2)

Maximum mortgage is EUR 325,000 = 100% of the value before renovation (EUR 300,000) plus the energy costs (EUR 25,000), provided the collateral has the 100% norm (e.g. a validated valuation report) (AB 1.3)
The 106% cap of the value after renovation (EUR 339,200) is not exceeded (AB 1.3)
forbidden: Giving a maximum other than EUR 325,000 for the 100%-norm situation
UC4.note: Changed 2026-11-05: the case text does not say how the house was valued. The policy gives a regular house 90% with a desktop valuation and 100% with a valuation report, and the 106% rule only applies at 100%. So an answer that gives EUR 325,000 on the condition of a valuation report (or asks for the valuation method) is correct.

required: A combination of maatwerk by using assets (inzet van vermogen) and exceptions that deviate on income is not allowed (AB 6.1)
Clients moving temporarily to the United Kingdom are not eligible for the diplomat clause (BB 4.1.1)
A new diplomat-clause request requires having lived in the home again for at least 1 year; 6 months is not enough (BB 4.1.1)
The son is 17; an applicant must be at least 18 (AB 2.1)
3 debtors are only possible via an Intermediair advisor AND with Plus conditions; this case is a Rabobank advisor with Basis conditions (AB 2.2)
forbidden: Saying interest-only is not allowed or exceeds the limit (EUR 60,000 is within 30% of EUR 350,000 = EUR 105,000 and within EUR 150,000)
Applying family-loan (leen-schenkconstructie / familielening) rules to this mortgage
Saying the loan-to-value is too high (EUR 340,000 = 97% is within 100% with a valuation report)
Saying the term of 30 years is too long

required: Interest-only is not allowed for a recreation home (AB 5.5.13)
Permanent living in a recreation-only home is not allowed; the exception requires a seller who already lives there permanently and is an existing Rabobank mortgage client (AB 5.5.13)
forbidden: Saying the loan-to-value is too high (EUR 180,000 = exactly 90% is allowed)

required: RRR R18 is outside the standard 1-16; acceptance is only possible via the Explain route (R17-R20 in specific situations, AB 2.4.2 / 6.2.1.1)
The houseboat rules apply to a woonark and the 85% loan is within the 90% limit (AB 5.5.12)
bonus: Asks for missing facts, e.g. the expected lifetime of the boat or the shore connection (walaansluiting)
forbidden: Saying the application can simply be accepted (ignoring the RRR)
Saying the loan-to-value is too high
